## ✅ Documentation Checklist
**For new documentation requests, should it include:**
- [ ] Step-by-step instructions
- [ ] Code examples
- [ ] Screenshots or diagrams
- [ ] Common troubleshooting tips
- [ ] Links to related documentation
- [ ] API reference information
- [ ] Security considerations
- [ ] Performance considerations

## 🌍 Localization
**Language considerations:**
- [ ] English documentation is sufficient
- [ ] Would benefit from Arabic translation
- [ ] Would benefit from other language translations
- [ ] Includes Islamic terminology that needs explanation

**Related documentation or feature issues:**
